Inclusion Criteria
  -  Adults age 18 years or older

right.raw_text: -  Diagnosed within 8 weeks with upfront resectable, [OR]  borderline resectable, [OR]  or locally advanced unresectable PDAC as defined by the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN)

left.raw_text: -  Planning to undergo TNT at MGH

right.raw_text: -  Planning to receive modified FOLFIRINOX for neoadjuvant chemotherapy

left.raw_text: -  Planning to undergo surgical resection of PDAC at MGH

right.raw_text: -  Previous treatment  [AND] for pancreas adenocarcinoma and no prior therapy for any cancer within 5 years

left.raw_text: -  Known history of cognitive  [OR] or psychologic impairment

right.raw_text: -  Known history of physical impairment such as immobility, use of walking aids, [OR]  or required wheelchair use

left.raw_text: -  Known history of the following orthopedic comorbidities: advanced osteoarthritis  [OR] or rheumatoid arthritis, mobility-limiting amputations, orthopedic injuries, [OR]  or widespread chronic pain (e

right.raw_text: -  Known history of the following pulmonary comorbidities: severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) defined as FEV1 ≤ 50%, emphysema, [OR]  interstitial lung disease, [OR]  and/or use of supplemental oxygen

left.raw_text: -  Known history of the following cardiovascular comorbidities: uncontrolled hypertension, severe congestive heart failure (NYHA  [OR] Class IV), and/or myocardial infarction within the last 6 months

right.raw_text: -  Inability  [OR] to tolerate diet through routine oral routes and/or patients with strict nutritional restrictions, allergies, [OR]  and/or dietary preferences
